subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should existing managed Kimi Coding API-key profiles automatically perform quota polling for OpenClaw status surfaces, following the provider-owned usage pattern used by bundled providers such as z.ai?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and has real endpoint evidence, but enabling credentialed quota polling by default is a persistent bundled-provider product and compatibility choice that tests cannot make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept managed Kimi quota polling
options.body: Approve automatic polling only for the official managed Kimi Coding endpoint and retain the custom-proxy skip behavior.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the quota implementation but expose it only through an approved explicit configuration or product flow for existing Kimi users.

options.title: Defer bundled status support
options.body: Decline this bundled-provider direction for now and leave Kimi quota reporting outside the default status pipeline.

recommendation.title: Accept managed Kimi quota polling
recommendation.body: Approve automatic polling only for the official managed Kimi Coding endpoint and retain the custom-proxy skip behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A repository-level bundled-provider scope decision is required before this otherwise bounded implementation can land.
